gitCommit.subject: fix: atomic result materialization via withTransaction (purses-nea) (#212)
gitCommit.body:
fix: atomic result materialization via withTransaction (purses-nea) (#212)

* docs(spec): transactional result materialization (purses-nea)

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 4.8 <noreply@anthropic.com>

* docs(spec): nea rev-2 — fold Data+Architect spec review (testability restructure, PgBouncer, retry predicate)

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 4.8 <noreply@anthropic.com>

* docs(spec): nea — fold re-review (all 4 constructor sites; cloneItemsFrom wording)

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 4.8 <noreply@anthropic.com>

* docs(plan): nea transactional materialization (4 TDD tasks)

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 4.8 <noreply@anthropic.com>

* refactor(repo): split SortResultRepository.create into insertWithNumber + retry wrapper (export isResultNumberConflict)

Extract a single-INSERT insertWithNumber (caller-supplied number, no
recompute, no retry) and re-implement create as a thin wrapper that
recomputes getNextResultNumber each attempt and retries on the exact
isResultNumberConflict predicate (now exported, single source of truth).
Add ResultNumberExhaustedError for the service's whole-tx retry to throw
on exhaustion. Fix stale neon-http no-long-transaction comment.

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 4.8 <noreply@anthropic.com>

* feat(sort): extract pure rankPreferencesToItems + cloneItemsFrom

Pure, DB-free materialization logic unit-tested directly: rank by score
desc with 0-based computedRank and rankBucket mapping; clone computed
fields into the create-input shape (no manual overrides). Mirrors the
current inline logic in createDraftResult/supersedeResult ahead of the
transactional rewire.

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 4.8 <noreply@anthropic.com>

* fix(sort): materialize results atomically via withTransaction (purses-nea)

createDraftResult + supersedeResult now write the result row + all item
rows inside a single transaction via a shared createResultWithItems
primitive. A mid-materialization failure (e.g. an item-INSERT FK 23503)
rolls the whole transaction back — no partial draft. The (collection,
number) race is retried at the transaction boundary, recomputing the
number each attempt, gated on the shared isResultNumberConflict
predicate; exhaustion throws ResultNumberExhaustedError.

SortResultService gains a db constructor param (4th); all four
constructing routes + the e2e seed pass it. Materialization writes use
ONLY tx-bound repos (new SortResultRepository(tx) / SortResultItemRepository(tx)),
never the injected repos.

Tests: un-mocked integration rollback proof (collection-scoped emptiness)
in sort-pipeline.integration.test.ts is RED before / GREEN after; route +
service unit tests use a fakeTxDb() helper whose .transaction runs the
callback; retired the now-bypassed injected-repo write assertions in
favor of tx-bound-write + guard assertions.

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 4.8 <noreply@anthropic.com>

* fix(sort): throw ResultNumberExhaustedError on number-allocation exhaustion + test (purses-nea review)

The retry catch threw the raw 23505 on the final attempt, so the
spec-mandated ResultNumberExhaustedError was unreachable. Move the named
throw into the conflict branch (continue while attempt<4, else throw the
distinct error); non-conflict errors still propagate unchanged. Trailing
throw kept as a defensive TS-return-type fallback.

Adds a unit test rejecting insertWithNumber 5x with a real-shaped 23505
conflict and asserting createDraftResult rejects with
ResultNumberExhaustedError (was: raw 23505 propagated).

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 4.8 <noreply@anthropic.com>

* chore(graphify): refresh graph for nea

* docs(arch): note transactional result materialization (purses-nea, first real transaction)

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 4.8 <noreply@anthropic.com>

* docs(api): note atomic materialization on POST + supersede (purses-nea)

---------

Co-authored-by: Claude Opus 4.8 <noreply@anthropic.com>
